A type `M₀` is a “monoid with zero” if it is a monoid with zero element, and `0` is left
and right absorbing.
name: MonoidWithZero

source.code:
/-- A type `M₀` is a “monoid with zero” if it is a monoid with zero element, and `0` is left
and right absorbing. -/
class MonoidWithZero (M₀ : Type u) extends Monoid M₀, MulZeroOneClass M₀, SemigroupWithZero M₀
